Discord Rich Presence for AI coding tools, on Linux, macOS and Windows.

## Install

**macOS:** [Download AgentPresence-macOS.dmg](https://github.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/releases/latest/download/AgentPresence-macOS.dmg), open it, double-click **Agent Presence**, click **Install**. Already installed? Open the new app and click **Update**.

**Linux / macOS terminal**
```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/main/install.sh | bash
```
**Windows** (PowerShell)
```
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

## New since v0.8.1

* **Mac app.** A double-click installer that also updates, restarts and uninstalls. No terminal, git or pip needed, and it walks you through Apple's Command Line Tools if Python is missing. The first launch needs **Open Anyway** in Privacy & Security.
* **Several computers, one card.** `agent-presence link` shares one card across your machines. The card follows whichever one you're using and counts agents on all of them (`🖥 2 machines: 💻 MacBook Pro (3) · 🖥 Aurora R16 (2)`). Each card also names the computer and OS, and never the hostname.
* **README card and website widget.** `agent-presence web setup --readme` puts a live card on your GitHub profile, and the `embed.js` widget adds a fuller panel to any site. Both are private by default: only public repos are named, with no file names, tokens or clock times. You choose which highlights to share. [Snippet generator](https://abelxmendoza.github.io/discord-agent-presence/#everywhere).
* **Private habit stats.** `agent-presence stats` (and `--html`) shows streaks, hours, sessions, peak times, projects, tools, models and test pass rate. This stays on your computer only.
* `agent-presence machines` lists linked computers; `setup --quiet`.

Discord cards work the same as before. Upgrading needs no config changes; new features are off until you run `link` or `web setup`.
